how we began

13 March 2026The day we met.
22 May 2026The day we became us.

Monu, read this one slowly

Thank you so much for choosing my stupid, forgetful, dumb ass every single day, for being the one person that feels like home, motivates me and keeps me grounded.

Ever since you've walked into my life, everything has felt like it's in the pro version. Like you've magically fixed everything and turned even the worst parts of me into the best ones.

Thank you for letting me in, and for trusting me with parts of yourself that I know no one else knows about. I promise to always protect them and never ever hurt you.

Sometimes I truly hate the distance, because wdym the universe decides to give me the best boyfriend on the face of the earth but keeps him 400 km away from me?

But then it's also given me someone who makes it so easy, yet so difficult, to deal with it. And I know that no matter what happens, we can always count on each other.

I love you so much, and I'm even more grateful to have someone as amazing as you in my life and by my side.

I'm so sorry that I forgot to wish you...
